title: release-engineering-meeting-notes-2026-05-05
content:
Release Engineering — Meeting notes
Date: 2026-05-05
Attendees: Jordan Patel (owner), Ava Chen, Samir Gupta, Lina Gomez, Mikhail Orlov, Priya Singh (SRE)
Absentees: none noted

Agenda:
- Quick sync on active release trains (stable, beta, canary)
- Current hotfix status and verification plan
- Recent change log highlights and outstanding PR rollbacks
- Blockers and action items

Summary / TL;DR:
- Stable train preparing v1.14.0 release targeted for 2026-05-07 (EOD). Beta rolled forward; canary running tests.
- Hotfix RE-342 (memory leak in kv-cache) patched and hotfixed in v1.13.3-hotfix1. Verification in progress; smoke looks good.
- Two change-log entries need wording polish before release notes: PR #4821 and #4830.
- One rollback candidate flagged (PR #4804) — revert paused pending deeper investigation.

Release trains:
- Canary: running perf/latency suite against 4 nodes. Observed intermittent 99th pct latency spike (~450ms) at ~20% traffic during batching experiment. Investigation owner: Samir. (related to RE-349)
- Beta: includes new kernel selection heuristics for seq-lengths >1024. No blocking failures; some timeouts in long-context tests. Action: run full eval harness on larger batch sizes. Owner: Lina.
- Stable: v1.14.0 candidate. Changelog drafted; final approvals needed from product and docs. Cut scheduled 2026-05-07 18:00 PDT. Owners: Jordan + Docs (Ava).

Hotfixes:
- RE-342: memory leak in kv-cache under continuous batching. Patch merged: github.com/redwood/release-engineering/pull/4821. Deployed to staging hotfix group and canary.
  - Verification: heap/GC graphs improving, no OOM in 6h stress window. Priya to run 24h soak on staging by EOD 2026-05-06.
  - Communication: CS notified for customers on dedicated pools. Draft sent to #release-ops.
- New hotfix candidate: spike in model-load latency observed for older RTX nodes (reported in RE-358). Quick mitigation: increase model load retry backoff in runtime to reduce thundering herd. Samir to open PR and run canary.

Change log highlights (items to include in v1.14.0 notes):
- Improved kernel selection for long-context workloads — reduced token compute by ~8% on average. (PR #4830)
- Fix: kv-cache memory leak under high concurrency (RE-342 / PR #4821)
- CLI: add --rollout=partial flag for safer canary deploys (internal CLI PR #4799)
- Docs: rollout runbook updated with new fallback policies (Confluence link included)

Rollbacks / Risks:
- PR #4804 (streaming: buffer reallocation change) flagged after test flake that may affect streaming stability for high-latency clients. Mikhail recommended pausing merge until we have a repro. Status: hold. Owner: Mikhail.
- Risk: Dedicated customers with pinned older runtime may still see the kv-cache leak. CS action required to identify pinned clusters and apply hotfix or schedule upgrade. Owner: Ava.

Action items (owner — due):
- Jordan: finalize v1.14.0 release notes and cut tag (due 2026-05-07 16:00 PDT)
- Ava: notify Dedicated customers with pinned runtimes, prepare upgrade playbook (due 2026-05-06 12:00 PDT)
- Priya: run 24h soak for RE-342 hotfix on staging and report metrics (due 2026-05-06 EOD)
- Samir: investigate 99th pct latency spike in canary, attach perf flame graphs (due 2026-05-06)
- Lina: run full eval harness for beta against seq-length >1024 workloads (due 2026-05-06)
- Mikhail: triage PR #4804, produce repro or rollback plan (due 2026-05-06)

Notes / Discussion points:
- We agreed to tighten the canary traffic ramp policy: new default ramp to 5% for first 30m, then 10% for next 30m if no regression. Samir to update rollout config in repo. (helps detect the 99th pct latency early)
- Consider adding a non-blocking memory profiler in the runtime for weekly health checks — POC suggested by Priya.
- Docs: include a short blurb in release notes about the --rollout=partial flag and how it interacts with Dedicated autoscaling. Ava will write.

Follow-ups / next meeting:
- Daily standup sync for hotfix owners until RE-342 fully verified (Priya to post daily updates in #release-ops)
- Next weekly release-engineering meeting: 2026-05-12 09:30 PDT

Misc (notes to self / TODOs):
- Add a short internal blurb for CS about detecting memory leak symptoms (high resident size, GC pauses)
- Re-check regression test coverage for streaming under high-latency networks

Links referenced in meeting:
- RE-342: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RE-342
- PR 4821: https://github.com/redwood/release-engineering/pull/4821
- PR 4830: https://github.com/redwood/release-engineering/pull/4830
- Release runbook: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/RE/Release+Runbook
- Slack: #release-ops (internal)

End of notes.
